propositions: The workflow editor must present both authored YAML/BPMN topology and a separate read-only Effective Policy view derived from built-ins plus project overlays, eliminating dual policy authority.

Effective Policy display includes criterion id, gate, execution tier, posture/threshold, applicability summary, enabled/disabled state, and derivation reason, sourced from repository-bound CriteriaSnapshot.
Project code-review LLM criteria must have non-empty applies_to globs; save validation rejects missing/empty/non-list selectors and suggests ["**"] for repository-wide coverage.
Built-in entries, project DET criteria, and plan-review criteria retain their distinct authoring controls and are exempt from the applies_to glob requirement.

Authored workflow remains byte-equivalent round-trippable while Effective Policy changes reflect policy updates; snapshot failures mark the policy view unavailable with actionable errors and prevent invalid saves.
Editor responses exclude execution traces, per-call debugging, prompt bodies, provider responses, and secrets.
